threats.scenario: The runtime connects to an unapproved public endpoint or exfiltrates data
threats.trustBoundary: Cloud Run runtime to public internet
threats.currentEvidence: No explicit Cloud Run VPC all-traffic egress or destination restrictions in supplied Terraform
threats.requiredMitigation: Agree destination allowlist, outbound network enforcement architecture and denied-destination negative tests

threats.scenario: A public caller reaches a service intended to be internal
threats.trustBoundary: External client to Cloud Run ingress
threats.currentEvidence: Cloud Run source declares internal ingress and IAM invoker checks enabled
threats.requiredMitigation: Independently verify effective ingress, invoker IAM and external-denial test in Google Cloud

threats.scenario: Runtime identity is overprivileged or obtains long-lived credentials
threats.trustBoundary: Cloud Run identity to Google Cloud APIs and secrets
threats.currentEvidence: Dedicated runtime service account declared, but effective IAM and key issuance not verified
threats.requiredMitigation: Independently review effective least-privilege grants, inherited IAM and key restrictions

threats.scenario: Unapproved dependency or DNS redirect leads traffic to an attacker
threats.currentEvidence: No authenticated outbound destination inventory or TLS enforcement evidence available
threats.requiredMitigation: Verify providers, domains, authentication, TLS and DNS controls; test denied hosts

threats.scenario: Network infrastructure is enabled before security review
threats.trustBoundary: GitHub CI to Google Cloud staging
threats.currentEvidence: Provisioning defaults off; workload federation provider declared disabled
threats.requiredMitigation: Retain separate approval and identity boundary, protected GitHub environment, signed provenance and review

threats.scenario: Private database or internal service is inadvertently exposed
threats.trustBoundary: Cloud Run runtime to data services
threats.currentEvidence: No database connectivity or private service topology established in supplied Terraform
threats.requiredMitigation: Confirm whether database access is required; if required, design private route and deny public access
